change.imageSources: camera/scanner -> system camera intent; library -> ACTION_GET_CONTENT

androidParityAfterThisChange.menuSpeechQuery: implemented via SpeechRecognizer (separate instance from SpeechInputPlugin), NOT device-verified
androidParityAfterThisChange.depthMeasurement: still unsupported on Android (ARKit on iOS; needs ARCore)

knownLimitations: Android menu OCR is single-page; iOS supports multi-page capture (pages/truncated). Android reports pages=1, truncated=false.

ML Kit exposes no per-line confidence. Line confidence is the average of element confidences; if the engine returns 0 for all elements it falls back to 1.0, otherwise menu_document's uncertain threshold (<0.5) would flag every line.
Android uses the system camera/gallery instead of the iOS in-app scanner, so there is no continuous multi-shot flow.
No Android device was attached (adb devices empty); nothing in this change has been exercised on hardware.
The speech query uses Android SpeechRecognizer; offline Cantonese availability depends on the device's on-device speech pack.
